task.description:
Fix E2E blockers TM-UI-04 and TM-UI-05 in web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts.

Root cause from TEST-RUNNER: fixture provisioning waits for onboarding completion and times out intermittently.

Implement deterministic fixture setup:
1. Create helper that first checks if tenant already exists before starting onboarding
2. If onboarding is started, poll robustly with retry/backoff and explicit terminal states
3. Add clear timeout diagnostics (include onboarding_id and last status in failure)
4. For TM-UI-04/TM-UI-05, avoid depending on transient UI progression for setup; use API polling helper and only navigate to Edit page after tenant existence is confirmed
5. Ensure cleanup is resilient and idempotent
6. Keep no-mock/no-stub policy

Validation required:
cd web
npx playwright test tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts --reporter=list
(should pass)

Then commit + push rework to feature/WF02-f8-batch1-20260606.
